patch_description: Instead of the prior "move off the hottest GPU" hill climb, this approach minimizes the sorted KVPR vector lexicographically (min the max, then the 2nd max, then 3rd...). This escapes plateaus where the max can't improve but redistributing pressure to the 2nd/3rd hottest GPUs later unlocks improvements. It scans candidate moves AND swaps from the top-3 hottest GPUs (not just the hottest), uses randomized multistart orderings (inspired by the Las Vegas recommendation but generalized), and keeps the best final max KVPR. Crash-proof: each attempt builds from scratch; failures just skip that restart.
